notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention (bank 't' = top half, 'b' = bottom half). The image labels the top half rows j-f and the bottom half e-a, so the image rows map as: top j,i,h,g,f -> t.a..t.e; bottom e,d,c,b,a -> b.f..b.j. Strips are identical, so only the column/bank matters electrically.

Rail holes: the bottom rail's upper row (black line) is negative 'bn', lower row (red line) is positive 'bp'. Exact hole index within a rail is read approximately from the image and does not matter electrically as each rail is one strip.

Pushbutton straddles the centre gap at columns 4 and 6. Sides are assumed per column: side 1 (1.l/1.r) = column 6 legs, side 2 (2.l/2.r) = column 4 legs. Pin 2 and the pull-down resistor are on column 6 (side 1); 5V (orange wire) is on column 4 (side 2).
Resistor is 10k ohm, from column 6 to column 9 of the bottom half; a black jumper at column 9 takes it to the GND rail.
Red wire goes to the Uno 5V pin; black wire goes to a GND pin (GND.1 chosen) on the power header.
Serial/USB connection to the computer is not modelled as a part.
